name: alidade
description: Competitive intelligence on social media messaging and digital marketing, with X post text filled in from your own X API key.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Alidade workspace: saved searches, entities, analytics, mentions, and semantic search. Alidade can't redistribute X post content, so X posts arrive as IDs; add your own X API bearer token and this extension fetches their text and metrics from the X API on your machine before Claude sees them.

alidade_api_key.title: Alidade API key
alidade_api_key.description: Create one under Settings → Workspace → API keys in Alidade.

x_bearer_token.title: X API bearer token (optional)
x_bearer_token.description: An app-only bearer token from your X developer account. Used to fetch X post text and metrics; X bills these lookups to your account. Leave empty to receive X post IDs only.
